background.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Edit target: attached Jun Heavenly Garden panoramic stage artwork. Redraw this same environment with CLEAR continuous edges and clean late-1990s pre-rendered low-poly scenery, removing its baked-in coarse pixel blocks and stippled noise. Retain the crooked pink cherry-blossom tree on the floating mossy island at the left third, distant floating stones, lotus flowers along the low waterline, pastel rainbow arcs, lavender sky and cream-pink clouds. Do not add subjects. Preserve the very wide panoramic composition and relative placements, horizon near 85 percent of the usable artwork height. Output as much actual artwork resolution as possible, ideally 4096 pixels wide with usable artwork 600 pixels tall. If padding is necessary, pure black only outside the panoramic band. NOT pixel art, no mosaic, no square brush blocks, no fake dithering, no grain, no photorealism, no modern bloom or hyperdetail. Simple shaded forms, readable branching and blossom masses, soft cloud gradients, era-appropriate materials. Bottom water strip must become quiet, almost uniform pale muted lavender-grey approximately RGB(181,163,187) #b5a3bb at its very bottom edge across the WHOLE width, no green cast, no strong foreground reflections or flowers along the bottom edge, so a separate nearly solid lavender-grey floor can join it. Keep the distant lotus and small reflections above that edge. Left/right sky and water heights/colours must match seamlessly. No fighters, UI, labels, borders or text. Produce the complete panorama only.

floor.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless square top-down game water-floor diffuse texture. Create almost completely uniform, STILL pale lavender-grey water, average colour RGB(180,160,203), hex #b4a0cb. Only extremely faint broad smooth tonal variation within 2 RGB levels, no visible patterned surface. All edges equal average colour and seamlessly tileable. This is the simple quiet water material in a late-1990s pre-rendered game, NOT pixel art: no baked pixel blocks, dither, grain or speckles. No green/teal/blue cast, no waves, flowing ripples, caustics, sparkle, reflections, stones, visible lakebed, petals, flowers, islands, horizon, border, text, UI or perspective. Full square only, pale lavender-grey material, mostly one simple colour.
